bio: A little outside the city centre, surrounded by greenery, this restaurant is located right next to its sister establishment, U Matěje. There are just a handful of tables in the modern yet rustic dining space, all with a direct view of the open kitchen. Here, the young team of chefs creates an ambitious 5- or 10-course suprise menu. Attentive service comes courtesy of charming waitstaff. Tip for motorists: You can park in front of the building – using a parking app is recommended....
